title: Patient Profile Management - General Statistics
content: General statistics on patient improvement rates at Harmony Health Clinic show a positive trend over the past year. The implementation of the new patient profile management system from MedTech Solutions has contributed to a more streamlined process, allowing for better tracking of patient progress and outcomes.

title: Personal Profile (Alex Thompson)
content:
Name: Alex Smith
Age: 24
Diagnosis: High-functioning autism spectrum disorder (ASD)
Interests: Alex enjoys a range of solo activities that require focus and attention to detail, such as building model airplanes, programming, and playing strategy video games. They also have a keen interest in marine biology, often spending hours reading about marine ecosystems and watching documentaries on the subject.
Communication Preferences
Verbal Communication: Alex is articulate but prefers brief, direct conversations. They sometimes miss social cues and may not always recognize non-verbal signals.
Non-Verbal Cues: Prefers clear and written instructions for tasks and schedules.
Social Interaction: Comfortable in small, familiar groups but finds large gatherings overwhelming.
Sensory Sensitivities
Auditory: Sensitive to loud noises. Uses noise-canceling headphones in noisy environments.
Visual: Prefers soft, natural lighting. Fluorescent lights can be uncomfortable.
Tactile: Dislikes tight or scratchy clothing. Prefers soft, loose-fitting fabrics.
Daily Routine & Medication Regimen
Morning: Wakes up at 7 AM, follows a structured routine including breakfast, personal hygiene, and medication. Takes a 20 mg dose of Fluoxetine with breakfast to manage symptoms of anxiety.
Midday: Engages in personal interests or attends job training sessions. Eats a pre-planned lunch to maintain a consistent diet.
Evening: Participates in family dinner, followed by leisure time dedicated to interests. Engages in a wind-down routine starting at 9 PM, including screen time limitation and reading.
Medication: Besides the morning dose of Fluoxetine, Alex takes a 10 mg dose of Melatonin an hour before bed to aid in sleep.

The patient profile management system provides a memo preview which is very helpful! Hopefully, it can be more user friendly - sometimes I just don't know what some buttons are for when checking Alex's profile.
